methods.name: joint_two_class_vpe
methods.description: One YOLOE visual-prompt pass with all six reference boxes and class IDs glass=0, ceramic_family=1.

methods.name: class_isolated_vpe
methods.description: Two independent YOLOE visual-prompt passes, each using the three reference boxes from one material class, followed by within-class NMS and union.

evaluation.score_semantics: raw YOLOE model score; uncalibrated and not a probability
evaluation.selection_rule: Report both preregistered methods. Do not select/tune a method, threshold, reference box, prompt class mapping or NMS setting using POS_2952166 if claiming independent evaluation.

display_rule: Renderer may display raw score as a percentage-like numeric model score for visual comparison with industrial overlays, but every showcase must state UNCALIBRATED MODEL SCORE and SOURCE-ASSISTED MATERIAL REFERENCE.
claim_boundary: Material-subtype portfolio experiment only; ceramic_family intentionally covers source-described ceramic/porcelain family. No material claim beyond the source-assisted reference, and no condition/defect/corrosion/failure/safety claim.
